title: Trimble GPS Field Protocol for Georeferencing
author: Sabine St-Jean
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.9zeh73e
materials: Sign in. The following screen will show up.
Slide the Connect to Trimble Catalyst button.
Wait for the precision to go down.

steps.title: Connect Trimble Antenna to Cellphone
steps.instruction: Connect the Trimble antenna to the field cellphone by plugging the antenna cable into the cellphone charging port.

steps.title: Connect External Battery to Antenna
steps.instruction: Connect the external battery to the Trimble antenna and secure the battery.

substeps.instruction: Plug the USB port into the battery.
Plug the micro USB port into the antenna.
Place the battery in its mount.

steps.title: Initialize Trimble Mobile Manager
steps.instruction: Open the Trimble Mobile Manager app on the fieldwork cellphone.

substeps.instruction: If the prompt appears, tick the 'Use by default for this USB accessory' box.

steps.title: Access Record in Fulcrum App
steps.instruction: Open the Fulcrum app and navigate to the specific plot or tree record intended for georeferencing.

substeps.instruction: Go to the 'Location' section of the record.

steps.title: Verify Horizontal Accuracy
steps.instruction: Monitor the Horizontal Accuracy value and wait for it to stabilize.

substeps.instruction: Ensure precision is acceptable: typically under 30 cm in leafless forest canopies, or as low as 2 cm in open environments.

steps.title: Update Georeference Location
steps.instruction: Once Horizontal Accuracy is stable at a good precision, click 'Update Location with GPS'.

substeps.instruction: Verify that Latitude, Longitude, Horizontal Accuracy, and Altitude values update.
